mapper.sql: id, scene_id::text as "sceneId", actor_id as "actorId", actor_name as "actorName", action, detail::text as detail, created_at as "createdAt"

select s.id::text as id, s.name, s.description, s.enabled, s.lock_version as "lockVersion", case when d.scene_id is not null then case when d.failure_reason is null then 'DELETING' else 'DELETE_FAILED' end when c.uploading > 0 then 'UPLOADING' when c.failed > 0 then 'FAILED' when c.total > 0 and c.available = c.total then 'READY' else 'PENDING' end as "uploadStatus", c.total as "fileCount", c.available as "availableCount", c.failed as "failedCount", c.bytes as "totalBytes", s.created_at as "createdAt", s.updated_at as "updatedAt" from ar_scene s left join ar_scene_deletion d on d.scene_id = s.id and d.completed_at is null cross join lateral ( select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where f.status = 'AVAILABLE') as available, count(*) filter (where f.status = 'FAILED') as failed, count(*) filter (where f.status = 'UPLOADING') as uploading, coalesce(sum(f.expected_bytes), 0)::bigint as bytes from ar_scene_file f where f.scene_id = s.id ) c where s.deleted_at is null
mapper.select: and position(lower(#{name}) in lower(s.name)) > 0 order by s.created_at desc, s.id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from ar_scene s where s.deleted_at is null and position(lower(#{name}) in lower(s.name)) > 0
select lock_version as "lockVersion", name, description, enabled, request_key::text as "requestKey" from ar_scene where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and deleted_at is null
select exists(select 1 from ar_scene where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and deleted_at is null)
select id::text from ar_scene where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and deleted_at is null for update
mapper.insert: insert into ar_scene(id, name, description, enabled, lock_version, request_key) values(cast(#{id} as uuid), #{name}, #{description}, true, 0, cast(#{requestKey} as uuid)) on conflict (request_key) do nothing

insert into ar_scene_file(id, scene_id, relative_path, expected_bytes, expected_sha256, storage_key, creator_id, creator_name, last_actor_id, last_actor_name) values
(cast(#{f.id} as uuid), cast(#{f.sceneId} as uuid), #{f.path}, #{f.bytes}, #{f.sha256}, #{f.id} || '.bin', #{f.actor}, #{f.actorName}, #{f.actor}, #{f.actorName})
mapper.update: update ar_scene set enabled = #{enabled}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = now() where deleted_at is null and id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and lock_version = #{version}
update ar_scene set deleted_at = now(), enabled = false, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and deleted_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into ar_audit(scene_id, actor_id, actor_name, action, detail) values(cast(#{id} as uuid), #{actor}, #{actorName}, #{action}, cast(#{detail} as jsonb))
mapper.select: select from ar_audit order by id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
